headline: EVER surges 120.0% over five days, leading prop sector gains.
market_take: The property sector showed mixed momentum with several stocks up around 10% (EVER, RML, CGD) while others fell near 9% (KUN, NVD). Food stocks generated strong volume spikes across CH, FM, ICHI, OSP and SUN, and SST announced a CFO resignation. In consumer, DEMCO rallied sharply (+11.04% 1‑day, +24.8% 5‑day) and TRITN displayed extreme volatility with a -33.33% open gap and a +50.00% intraday swing. PF&REIT experienced dramatic -100% gaps in QHOP and M‑PAT.
